items.title: Stop Treating CSS Container Queries Like Traditional Media Queries
items.summary_original: To be completely honest with you, I missed the news when CSS Container Queries first shipped. And when I finally heard about it, my very first thought was, “Why exactly do I need this when media queries already exist?” I’m not proud of that reaction, knowing what I know now, but it was comforting to know that I wasn’t alone. In fact, there are legions of us out there. What baffles me is that container queries aren’t a new feature, as it currently sits at around 94% browser support . And yet, very few people are actually using it. According to the State of CSS survey, 86% of developers are aware of container queries, but only 41.4% actually use them. Surveys can be biased and not completely representative of our entire field, but this one is certainly the best indicator we’ve got. Kevin Pow

The project repositions the museum as an open civic space where design is used to examine how objects, cities and social systems are shaped. The new 2,200-square-meter wing completes the fragmented museum complex around its historic courtyard and introduces freely accessible spaces for exhibitions , workshops, lectures, events and community activity. items.title: Ellie Campbell turns club nights into hand-painted, gloriously wonky animations
items.summary_original: Growing up in Weston-super-Mare, the artist found an escape in cartoons and animation. Now, she's turning that lifelong obsession into painstakingly painted rotoscoped works that are full of life and cracking dance moves. There is something wonderfully stubborn about painting an animation frame by frame. While the moving image is usually associated with speed and technology, Ellie Campbell is interested in exactly what happens when you slow the whole thing down and use a paintbrush to create the visuals. Her hand-painted rotoscope animations take real footage and pull it apart, exaggerating bodies and gestures into familiar scenes – throwing shapes on the dancefloor, watching a duck swim across the pond or sipping a cold frosty pint to name just a few. items.title: FONS HICKMANN
items.summary_original: The Brandenburgisches Landesmuseum für moderne Kunst (Brandenburg Museum of Modern Art) presents a substantial solo exhibition of posters by Fons Hickmann at the Dieselkraftwerk Cottbus, bringing together work from more than three decades. The exhibition spans early and recent posters, international commissions, cultural projects, political interventions and self-initiated work. Rather than presenting a strictly chronological retrospective, it traces the continuities, shifts and contradictions within a practice in which commissioned design and autonomous artistic work have increasingly come together. Typography, image and language form the basis of Hickmann’s work, often engaging with cultural, political and social subjects. Many of the posters shown have received international recognition

Seine Fotoserie konzentriert sich auf die skulpturale Geometrie des Gebäudes und zeichnet den Übergang von seinem strahlend weißen Äußeren zur warmen, komplexen Holzstruktur im Inneren nach. Die 2013 fertiggestellte Kapelle war als Raststätte für Reisende neben der Autobahn konzipiert. You click menus, adjust range sliders, fill out multi-step forms, deal with cookie pop-ups, and open dozens of browser tabs just to cross-reference basic information. items.title: LinkedIn für Kreative: sichtbar werden, Vertrauen aufbauen, Kund:innen gewinnen
items.summary_original: Wie können Kreative LinkedIn strategisch nutzen, um sichtbar zu werden, Vertrauen aufzubauen und relevante Auftraggeber:innen zu erreichen? Karolina Zolubak zeigt in zwei Stunden, wie Profil, Netzwerk und Content zusammenspielen – und wie daraus eine LinkedIn-Strategie für den eigenen Arbeitsalltag entsteht. Viele Kreative sind auf LinkedIn zwar angemeldet, nutzen die Plattform aber nicht strategisch. Das Profil gleicht einem digitalen Lebenslauf, das Netzwerk ist eher zufällig gewachsen und beim Thema Content fehlt oft ein Plan. Dabei bietet LinkedIn gerade für Kreative die Möglichkeit, die eigene Expertise sichtbar zu machen, Beziehungen zu potenziellen Kund*innen aufzubauen und dafür zu sorgen, dass relevante Menschen auf die eigene Arbeit aufmerksam werden. items.title: BIG LETTERS, BRIGHT COLORS
items.summary_original: Letters, words, sentences: in contemporary painting, they carry not only literal meaning but can become an independent pictorial motif in their own right. The Kunsthalle Emden dedicates a new exhibition to this field of tension: “GROSSE BUCHSTABEN, GRELLE FARBEN (BIG LETTERS, BRIGHT COLOURS)” (August 15, 2026 – February 28, 2027) brings together around twenty works by contemporary artists and asks how lettering functions within an image: What does it add to the work, how is it shaped artistically? Can script convey something that cannot be captured in words alone? Script within the image has been an art-historical subject since at least classical modernism. items.summary_original: FOLIO is a non-alcoholic botanical drink made from cold-pressed cucumber and hemp extract. Positioned between wellness and craft collectibility, it combines functional ingredients with a strong focus on physical presence and perception. The packaging draws inspiration from limited-edition spirits. Numbered bottles, handwritten batch tags, and small-run production communicate rarity and intention, bringing a premium approach rarely seen in the non-alcoholic category. items.summary_original: The craft was learned at this table, one marked-up screen at a time. AI assisted, Automation is taking tasks juniors learned on. Here are seven tasks that put the practice back so we keep human element of user experience and build the bench for 2030. Many teams I know have stopped assigning transcript tagging because now AI does it. Their platform of choice returns sessions tagged, themed, and clipped transcripts before anyone opens them, and does it well enough. Nobody argued, and nobody wrote down what else that task did. items.summary_de: Das Handwerk wurde an diesem Tisch erlernt, ein markierter Bildschirm nach dem anderen. KI-unterstützt übernimmt die Automatisierung die Aufgaben, die die Junioren gelernt haben. Hier sind sieben Aufgaben, die die Praxis zurückbringen, damit wir das menschliche Element der Benutzererfahrung beibehalten und die Basis für 2030 schaffen. Viele Teams, die ich kenne, haben aufgehört, Transkript-Tagging zuzuweisen, weil dies jetzt von der KI übernommen wird. Die Plattform ihrer Wahl gibt Sitzungen mit Tags, Themen und ausgeschnittenen Transkripten zurück, bevor sie jemand öffnet, und das gelingt ihr recht gut. Niemand widersprach und niemand schrieb auf, was diese Aufgabe sonst noch bewirkte. Durch das Markieren von Redlines erfährt ein neuer Designer, welche Abstandsentscheidungen das System getroffen hat und welche offen sind. Diese Arbeit war nie wichtig

items.title: design for humanity at play: compasso d’oro international design award 2027 calls for entries
items.summary_original: COMPASSO D’ORO INTERNATIONAL DESIGN AWARD OPENS SUBMISSIONS Entries are open until January 20, 2027 for the Compasso d’Oro International Design Award 2027, organized by Association for Industrial Design (ADI) in collaboration with the Bureau International des Expositions (BIE). Centered on the theme ‘Design for Humanity at Play,’ the award invites designers, brands, and institutions participating in Expo 2027 Belgrade to submit projects developed between January 01, 2023 and December 31, 2026. Framing play as a vital mechanism for connection and speculative thinking, the competition challenges the creative community to explore how design can foster connection, participation, and resilience across nine distinct project categories. items.title: The DFB-Pokal Reimagined
items.summary_original: The DFB-Pokal thrives on contrast: professional clubs facing semi-professional sides, favourites meeting underdogs, and decades of tradition colliding with stories that can unfold in a single night. Its new visual identity seeks to make that tension visible. Introduced for the 2026/27 season, the rebrand brings the men’s, women’s and junior competitions into a shared design system while giving each its own character and expression. At the heart of the new approach is a fundamental question: how can a brand built on consistency capture a competition defined by unpredictability? In this interview, Holger Merk, Head of Brand Department, discusses the thinking behind the new identity, the role of contrast, the balance between tradition and digital culture, and how design can create a framework

Aber es gibt eine gewisse Aufmerksamkeit, die ihre Arbeit flüstern lässt – eine Art Signal „Wenn du schon weißt, dass du schon weißt“. Im Gespräch mit den Gründern des Studios, den Designern Stefano Panterotto und Alexis Tourron, erinnern sie sich an die lustigen Orte, an denen ihre Arbeiten auftauchten, von einer Balenciaga-Kerze auf dem Couchtisch von Supermodel Bella Hadid bis zu ihren Lampen in einer futuristischen Apple TV-Show. Doch wenn man mit den beiden spricht, die dunkle Pullover tragen, die fast archetypisch für das Industriedesign sind, hat man das deutliche Gefühl, dass dies nicht der Fall ist

items.title: masks, spirits, and mythical figures carry peruvian heritage into WESR’s murals across europe
items.summary_original: WESR brings together Peruvian heritage and urban culture At the center of WESR’s practice is a continuous movement between places, cultures, and identities. Born in Chiclayo, Peru , in 1980, Danny Figueroa, known as WESR, began painting graffiti in Lima in 1996 before moving to Berlin , where he lives and works today. His practice spans murals, studio painting, illustration , and ceramics . Drawing on the visual traditions of the Peruvian Andes and contemporary urban culture, WESR creates figures that exist between human, animal, and spirit. This relationship between traditional imagery and contemporary graphic language is particularly visible in his murals. items.title: Lingo
items.summary_original: Imagine a library. Sealed-in quiet, walls thick as dictionaries. But that's not why you're here — you're at the computer, navigating to your personal linguistic authority: Urban Dictionary. Feverishly typing in the word on your mind since it left your crush's lips in math class: turnt. A thrill washes over you. Not just the definition, but the sight of it: turnt, turned from spoken to serif. Dignified. Elevated. To see slang suited up feels almost subversive. And just right. That's where Softdrive's new typeface, Lingo, comes from. Timeless elegance meets current trend, intellectual authority meets the people's slang. Lingo is both a workhorse, trotting along in body copy, and a show pony, shining in display. This serif respects classical typographic tradition... until it doesn't. Lingo ha

items.title: Celebrating 20 Years of Open Movies
items.summary_original: This year we are celebrating 20 years of making Open Movies. 17 titles, all different and beautiful in their own way. We want to thank you for being a part of this journey – without the community support, all of these projects would not be possible! To celebrate the 20 years of Open Movies in a special way during the Blender Conference 2026, we have created an installation that represents the projects frame by frame. And in the spirit of sharing and being open, visitors of the exhibition can take a frame with them. 20 years of Open Movies exhibition at Blender Conference 2026 Thank you for doing your part. Let’s see what the next decade of open filmmaking will bring!
